data.name: Hitendra
data.gender_notes: Hitendra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hitendra is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'hita' (sun) and 'andra' (male, man). It symbolizes the energy and vitality of the sun and the spirit of a man. In Hindu mythology, Hitendra is the name of several gods and heroes. The name Hitendra carries the meaning “Sun's energy” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hitendra usually hope their child will grow to embody sun's energy and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embodying the radiant energy of the sun.
data.etymology: Hitendra belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun's energy.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hitendra total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

historical_references.reference: Hitendra Champat Rai (1858-1936) was a renowned Indian scholar, lawyer, and politician. He was a prominent leader of the Indian National Congress and served as the President of the Congress from 1922 to 1924. During his tenure, he advocated for nonviolent resistance and was a key figure in the Indian independence movement.
